credentials.title: OpenStack credentials
credentials.intro: One credential per OpenStack project. Deployments run in the project of the credential chosen in the wizard; everyone with a credential for the same project can see and manage its deployments, always with their own credential. Saving a credential for a project that already has one replaces it.
credentials.emptyMessage: Deploying needs an application credential (recommended) or a user name and password for an OpenStack project.

credentials.yamlHint: The clouds.yaml Horizon offers for download.
credentials.cloudNameHint: Only if the file lists more than one cloud.
credentials.appCredentialHint: Recommended: an application credential belongs to one project and can be revoked on its own (Horizon → Identity → Application Credentials).
credentials.passwordHint: The password is stored encrypted. An application credential is the safer choice.
